lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag maaroo baanee jaideu jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Jai Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਸਤ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਨਾਦ ਸਤ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੂਰ ਸਤ ਖੋੜਸਾ ਦਤੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)d sat bhediaa naad sat pooriaa soor sat khoRasaa dat keeaa ||
lines.translation: The breath is drawn in through the left nostril; it is held in the central channel of the Sushmanaa, and exhaled through the right nostril, repeating the Lord's Name sixteen times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਲ ਬਲੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ਅਚਲ ਚਲੁ ਥਪਿਆ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਆ ਤਹਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: abal bal toRiaa achal chal thapiaa aghaR ghaRiaa tahaa apiu peeaa ||1||
lines.translation: I am powerless; my power has been broken. My unstable mind has been stabliized, and my unadorned soul has been adorned. I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਆਦਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man aad gun aad vakhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Within my mind, I chant the Name of the Primal Lord God, the Source of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree dubidhaa drisat sa(n)maaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My vision, that You are I are separate, has melted away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਧਿ ਕਉ ਅਰਧਿਆ ਸਰਧਿ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਸਲਲ ਕਉ ਸਲਲਿ ਸੰਮਾਨਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aradh kau aradhiaa saradh kau saradhiaa salal kau salal sa(n)maan aaiaa ||
lines.translation: I worship the One who is worthy of being worshipped. I trust the One who is worthy of being trusted. Like water merging in water, I merge in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਕਉ ਰੰਮਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: badat jaideu jaidev kau ra(n)miaa braham nirabaan liv leen paaiaa ||2||1||
lines.translation: Says Jai Dayv, I meditate and contemplate the Luminous, Triumphant Lord. I am lovingly absorbed in the Nirvaanaa of God. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥ ਮਾਰੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer || maaroo ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, Maaroo:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿਗਾ ਮਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam simar pachhutaahigaa man ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, or else you will regret it in the end, O mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapee jeearaa lobh karat hai aaj kaal uth jaahigaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O sinful soul, you act in greed, but today or tomorrow, you will have to get up and leave. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalach laage janam gavaaiaa maaiaa bharam bhulaahigaa ||
lines.translation: Clinging to greed, you have wasted your life, deluded in the doubt of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਗਦ ਜਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhan joban kaa garab na keejai kaagad jiu gal jaahigaa ||1||
lines.translation: Do not take pride in your wealth and youth; you shall crumble apart like dry paper. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਪਟਕੈ ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau jam aai kes gahi patakai taa din kichh na basaahigaa ||
lines.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by the hair, and knocks you down, on that day, you shall be powerless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: simaran bhajan daiaa nahee keenee tau mukh chotaa khaahigaa ||2||
lines.translation: You do not remember the Lord, or vibrate upon Him in meditation, and you do not practice compassion; you shall be beaten on your face. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai jab lekhaa maagai kiaa mukh lai kai jaahigaa ||
lines.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for your account, what face will you show Him then?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿਗਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu saadhasa(n)gat tar jaa(n)higaa ||3||1||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag maaroo baanee ravidaas jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਲਾਲ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee laal tujh bin kaun karai ||
lines.translation: O Love, who else but You could do such a thing?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gareeb nivaaj gusaeeaa meraa maathai chhatr dharai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Patron of the poor, Lord of the World, You have put the canopy of Your Grace over my head. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਛੋਤਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਪਰ ਤੁਹਂੀ ਢਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee chhot jagat kau laagai taa par tuha(n)ee dharai ||
lines.translation: Only You can grant Mercy to that person whose touch pollutes the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਹ ਊਚ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਨ ਡਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: neechah ooch karai meraa gobi(n)d kaahoo te na darai ||1||
lines.translation: You exalt and elevate the lowly, O my Lord of the Universe; You are not afraid of anyone. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਧਨਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamadev kabeer tilochan sadhanaa sain tarai ||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan, Sadhana and Sain crossed over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas sunahu re sa(n)tahu har jeeu te sabhai sarai ||2||1||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, listen, O Saints, through the Dear Lord, all is accomplished. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo ||
lines.translation: Maaroo:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਰਿਤਰੁ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar suritar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke re ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the jewel of miracles and the wish-fulfilling cow are all under His power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat mahaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa kai ||1||
lines.translation: The four great blessings, the eight great miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures are in the palm of His hand. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har na japas rasanaa ||
lines.translation: Why don't you chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਛਾਡਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar sabh chhaad bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Abandon all other devices of words. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਛਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan bed bidh chautees achhar maahee ||
lines.translation: The many epics, the Puraanas and the Vedas are all composed out of the letters of the alphabet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਸ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: biaas beechaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
lines.translation: After careful thought, Vyaasa spoke the supreme truth, that there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat hoi bade bhaag liv laagee ||
lines.translation: In intuitive Samaadhi, their troubles are eliminated; the very fortunate ones lovingly focus on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas udaas daas mat janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||2||15||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord's slave remains detached from the world; the fear of birth and death runs away from his mind. ||3||2||15||
